selection_reasoning: 9 tasks forming a coherent multi-hop DAG with two main paths: (1) Exploration path: yellow_bed → potted_poppy → scaffolding → brown_banner → nether_wart_block, guiding the player from bedroom through courtyard to workshop via visual landmarks. (2) Crafting/mining path: yellow_bed → potted_blue_orchid → barrel → craft wooden_pickaxe → mine polished_granite, where the player discovers materials and tools progressively. The 'mine redstone_block' task was replaced with 'find nether_wart_block' because redstone_block requires an iron pickaxe (unavailable in this scene). All tasks are now achievable with available tools and scene resources.

edges.reason: The potted_blue_orchid is in the storage alcove on the opposite side of the bedroom from the yellow_bed; finding the bed orients exploration toward the alcove
The potted_poppy is on the north windowsill across the room from the yellow_bed; finding the bed initiates room exploration leading to the poppy
The barrel is hidden behind a half-wall adjacent to the orchid shelf; discovering the orchid draws attention to the alcove where the barrel is concealed
The barrel is the sole source of sticks and planks needed to craft the wooden_pickaxe — no other material sources exist in the scene
The scaffolding tower in the courtyard is visible through the east window near the poppy; finding the poppy leads the player to exit and discover the scaffolding
The brown_banner rests on a support block directly above the scaffolding tower; approaching scaffolding and looking up reveals the banner
The nether_wart_block is embedded in the workshop wall near the banner; finding the banner directs the player toward the workshop entrance
Polished granite requires at least a wooden_pickaxe to mine and obtain the drop item

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The barrel is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 5), hidden behind the half-wall at (7, 1-2, 4). Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown_banner is at spawn-relative (10, 5, 4), elevated on a support block above the scaffolding. max_distance=6 accounts for the vertical offset (player at Y~1, banner at Y=5, giving ~4 blocks vertical distance). facing_tolerance=75 is wider to accommodate the upward pitch angle needed to look at the elevated banner.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_pickaxe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts without any wooden_pickaxe, so having min_count=1 confirms successful crafting. Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The distinctive dark red block contrasts with surrounding stone_bricks, making it visually identifiable.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_granite with a wooden_pickaxe or better causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts without any polished_granite, so min_count=1 confirms successful mining. Polished granite is at (12, 1, 8) in the workshop wall and is confirmed mineable with a wooden pickaxe.

scene_description: A compact compound with two buildings connected by an outdoor courtyard. Building 1 (bedroom/storage, X=1-8, Z=1-8) contains a yellow bed on the south side, a potted poppy on the north windowsill, and an east-side storage alcove with a potted blue orchid on a shelf and a barrel hidden behind a half-wall containing crafting materials (2 sticks + 3 oak planks). The outdoor courtyard features a scaffolding tower at X=10,Z=4 with an oak_planks support block and brown banner on top. Building 2 (workshop, X=10-14, Z=7-12) contains polished granite and nether_wart_block in its walls, plus a crafting table. No /give commands — barrel is the sole material source.
task_text: Explore the craftsman's compound. Find the yellow bed in the bedroom, then locate the potted poppy on the far windowsill and the potted blue orchid in the storage alcove. Discover the barrel hidden behind the half-wall and collect its materials (sticks and planks) to craft a wooden pickaxe at the workshop's crafting table. Outside, find the scaffolding tower and the brown banner mounted above it, then locate the nether wart block in the workshop wall. Finally, use your pickaxe to mine the polished granite block.
